# African Swine Fever Risk

<p class="geoepi-project-summary">Model-based analyses for African Swine Fever risk assessment.</p>

## Abstract

This GeoEpi project brings together work on model-based analyses for African Swine Fever risk assessment. The project currently includes registered analytical work under the ASF-GBRTs subproject.
